text:
I can't say the asset is "deforestation-free," because the evidence doesn't make a compliance finding. What it does show is that no tree-cover loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected within ASSET-E (438.6 ha) between 2021 and 2025. Hansen data covered 100% of the asset.

Context:
- The asset had 34.5 ha of tree cover in 2000 (Hansen, ≥30% canopy).
- The JRC reference map shows 0 ha of forest in 2020, so there was no forest baseline to lose after 2020.

Limits:
- Smaller changes (under 0.5 ha), edge changes, or features narrower than the 30 m pixels may be missed, so this doesn't prove there was no change at all.
- It covers only 2021–2025.
- The MGAP 2021 source was unavailable.
- It isn't an EUDR or other regulatory determination.

Any compliance conclusion would need separate assessment, including checks of the other legal requirements.
